✅ Last answer: C, Ag₂CrO₄ in water, AgCl in 0.01 M AgNO₃.
Water: AgCl s ≈ 1.3 × 10⁻⁵ M, Ag₂CrO₄ s ≈ 6.5 × 10⁻⁵ M. With 0.01 M Ag⁺: AgCl s = 1.8 × 10⁻⁸ M, Ag₂CrO₄ s = Ksp/[Ag⁺]² = 1.1 × 10⁻⁸ M. The squared [Ag⁺] flips the order.

mRNA = 5′-GCAUGAAACCCUGAUGGUAA-3′. The ribosome starts at the first AUG: AUG (Met) – AAA (Lys) – CCC (Pro) – UGA (stop). A stop codon adds no amino acid, so the chain is 3 long.

✅ Last answer: 1009 zeros.
Each base-12 zero needs 12 = 2²·3. 2026! has 1010 threes and 2018 twos, and the twos give only 2018 ÷ 2 = 1009 twelves. So the 2s run out first: 1009.

A block tied under water, inside a lift that's speeding up. Does the string feel it? 🛗💧

Block: 600 kg/m³, 1000 cm³, held under water by a string. The lift accelerates UP at 5 m/s². Tension? NSEP-level fluids.

Comment your answer 👇 Solution tomorrow.

✅ Last answer: A, mgR/12.
In a circular orbit E = −GMm/2r = −mgR²/2r. E(2R) = −mgR/4, E(3R) = −mgR/6. Energy needed = mgR/4 − mgR/6 = mgR/12. The PE rises by mgR/6, but the satellite gives back mgR/12 of KE.
